ios.desc:
Notation is a chess coaching app that teaches you why — not just what.

Every chess evaluation comes from Stockfish 18, running entirely on your device. Every pattern, weakness, and tactical motif is detected by hand-tuned on-device classifiers built on decades of coaching theory. The language model's only job is the last step: explaining what the analysis found, in plain English, like a coach sitting next to you.

The chess is never generated. It's explained.

THREE COACHING FRAMEWORKS

Notation is the first chess app to operationalise multiple grandmaster-level coaching frameworks as deterministic measurement:

• Dan Heisman's seven positional elements — Mobility, Vulnerability, Centre Control, Coordination, Speed, Time, Flexibility — measured per-position with super-GM baselines
• Jeremy Silman's coaching emphasis frames — fifteen frames choosing what to teach at each moment
• Jacob Aagaard's positional predicates — Where are the weaknesses? Which is the worst-placed piece? What's the opponent's plan?

All computed on-device. All deterministic. The same principles human coaches have used for decades, encoded into classifiers that run before the language model ever sees the position.

GAME REVIEW

Every game gets a coherent on-device review — no API key needed, no internet, no cost. Template-driven narrative against the full coaching substrate. When you want depth, upgrade once with your own Anthropic or OpenAI API key, o ruse the On Device LLM with no additional costs and the richer review becomes the permanent artefact for that game. Nadia comments on at most six moments — only the ones worth learning from. PDF export of every review.

PLAYER PROFILE

Style axes — Aggression, Tactical Alertness, Positional Play, Endgame — derived from the substrate with confidence bands. The seven Heisman elements sit below as evidence. Full-screen iPad dashboard. PDF coaching report you could hand to a human coach.

OPPONENT SCOUTING & MATCHUP REPORTS

Scout reports surface the full eight-axis substrate on any opponent. How-to-play-against framing with concrete suggestions. Player-vs-opponent comparison across all axes with weakest-phase detection.

SHADOW — YOUR CHESS TWIN

Shadow learns how you play and saves checkpoints. Play yourself from six months ago. See how far you've come. Coming soon: calibrate Shadow to your real-life rivals by importing their games.

PLAY ON YOUR PHYSICAL BOARD

Pair with Chessnut Air, Pro, Go, Air+ and Move over Bluetooth. Notation track

quotes.text:
Hi HN. 
Solo iOS middle aged, slightly burnt out dad from the UK here, wondering if anyone is interested in what I've been building. 
Lifelong chess fan, not very good but always trying to improve and I started to build Notation: Chess coach a while back. 
It's been live a month now on the App Store, doing modest numbers, and I've been learning a lot... mainly make my add brain slow down, stop, test everything twice and never when tired. Submissions will always wait another day!

Many people play on chess com, or lichess, just as many in apps and OTB. What my app does (differently I hope) is bring that data together.

You can import PGNs of your games, connect to chess com and lichess and sync your games over or play in the app. 
If you have a Chessnut electronic board, you can play IRL on that as well.

Every game, every move is then analysed by a series of on device detectors, and classifiers. And I'm not talking about"I run Stockfish 18 and get your move evals" like most tools do.... Theres a LOT more to it.

Happy to go into detail in the comments if anyones interested!

Then, it takes all that data (ON DEVICE - No ads, no trackers, no subscriptions, no data sharing unless you want to send it to someone) to create your playing profile, which you can see on a dashboard, or pdf export - its your coaching report - shows you where and how to improve.
